A portfolio of counterparties changes all the time: insolvency filings, court actions, new directors or owners.

Re-collect the sources on a schedule, fingerprint the content, classify each change and alert only on the material ones, with backpressure so load never hides a failure.

It draws on these skills: [Insolvency monitoring](@/skills/insolvency-monitoring.md), [Continuous monitoring](@/skills/change-monitoring.md), [Registry intelligence](@/skills/registry-intelligence.md), [Entity resolution](@/skills/entity-resolution.md), [Orchestration](@/skills/orchestration.md) and [Risk scoring](@/skills/risk-scoring.md).

It is built with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [Broadway](@/glossary/broadway.md), [Phoenix](@/glossary/phoenix.md) and [PostgreSQL](@/glossary/postgresql.md).

The technologies behind it, measured from the work that shows those skills: [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md), [FastAPI](@/glossary/fastapi.md), [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md) and [GitHub Actions](@/glossary/github-actions.md).

2 public repositories show its skills (2 by their own words).

It was delivered in client work under confidentiality agreements, in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group, as Architect, Lead engineer, AI engineer, Data engineer, Investigator and Advisor; the use cases describe the principle and the intent, never a client, person, date or number.

How to read this page: the method and the use cases are written by me; the skills, technologies and public evidence are derived from measured data and link to their own pages, each a [repository](@/glossary/repository.md), a term or a skill.
